rationale: The agent verified the user’s identity correctly using full name and zip code, locating a single matching account. It retrieved the grill order details, confirmed the status was pending, and did not execute a cancellation without explicit confirmation; the user then chose to keep the order, and the agent accurately confirmed no change was made. For the t-shirt inquiry, the agent checked a delivered order, correctly reported there was only one t-shirt and provided accurate details (color, size, style, material) from the tool data, and asked for an order reference to search for a second t-shirt, avoiding fabrication. No policy violations occurred: no writes without confirmation, no acting on the wrong user, and all information provided was supported by the tools.
